settings.heading: Jazz Class — Winter 2026
settings.lede: This winter, children will discover the rhythm of jazz through music, movement, and play. Our guided sessions help build listening skills and creative confidence, leading up to a special onstage performance where children get to play instruments and the audience feels the music.

settings.body: Empowering children through dance and theatre programs
Year-round performances that establish teamwork and skill-development
Community-driven arts education rooted in inclusivity and care

settings.heading: Bring the Stage to Life
settings.lede: Our programs and performances are only possible through the generosity of our donors. This support allows the organization to expand, providing meaningful classes for children and creating new ways for communities to re-engage.

settings.quote: Supporting OUAT has been incredibly rewarding. Seeing how thoughtfully the programs are designed for children.
As a long-time supporter, I’ve seen firsthand how OUAT uses the arts to bring stories to life and create opportunities for young performers.
OUAT exceeded my expectations. Supporting their work has allowed me to help programs reach more communities.

settings.title: What drives us to do the work that we do?
settings.body: Seeing young performers shine on stage is the heart of this work. Once Upon a Time dedicates every effort to ensuring children receive a high-quality education in the arts, giving them the chance to grow, perform, and make their families proud.

settings.title: Who benefits?
settings.body: The entire community benefits — from the children discovering their creative potential to the families who see them grow. This work is made possible by the donors and contributors who invest in our staff and programs, ensuring Once Upon a Time remains a place where the next generation can experience the arts.

settings.title: How do our programs transform a child’s journey?
settings.body: Our programs at Once Upon a Time establish the core fundamentals of teamwork. We want to provide children a collaborative space where they can build connections, bring their inner creativity out, and be proud of their accomplishments to share with their parents and families.
